Brand name help: Replaces 'NocoBase' text in the top-right header and login page. Defaults to Digit.
About content help: Content shown in the top-right corner pop-up. Leave empty to hide completely. Supports HTML. System version is displayed automatically.
Brand help: Shown at the bottom of the login page. Defaults to 'Powered by Digit' when empty. Supports HTML.
Dropdown links help: Replaces default links (Home, User Manual, etc.) in the top-right dropdown. New links appear in the dropdown; leave URL empty to disable navigation.
